changelog:
Initial release of openclaw-claude-dispatcher.

- Enables dispatch of long-running coding tasks to Claude Code CLI with automatic callback notifications.
- Notifies users via Feishu or WeCom upon task completion.
- Supports project creation, code upgrades, refactoring, and other codebase improvements.
- Guides selection of project directories and notification channels, with sensible defaults.
- Provides clear instructions for dispatch commands and confirmation of task handling.
